articles.description: — Brook Lopez scored 26 points and Darius Garland added 24 as the Los Angeles Clippers finished off a 113-112 victory Friday night in an NBA Cup game, sending the short-handed Oklahoma City Thunder to a season-high third straight loss.

articles.headline: Warriors' Yaxel Lendeborg (1-for-13) 'flustered' in blowout loss to Spurs
articles.description: In his first game as the primary offensive engine in place of the injured Stephen Curry, Warriors rookie Yaxel Lendeborg went 1-of-13 shooting in a 123-85 blowout loss to the Spurs. "I was flustered the entire game," he said. "Couldn't make a damn layup."

images.name: Yaxel Lendeborg [600x400]
images.caption: "I'm not going to move past this," Warriors rookie Yaxel Lendeborg said after Friday's blowout loss to the Spurs. "I don't know about the rest of us. Everybody said throw it out the window. I can't throw a damn thing out the window."

articles.headline: Castle scores season-high 32 points as Spurs stop the Warriors 123-85 for 11th straight win
articles.description: — Stephon Castle scored a season-high 32 points, Victor Wembanyama had 12 points and 12 rebounds and the San Antonio Spurs won their 11th straight game, rolling past the Golden State Warriors 123-85 Friday night to remain unbeaten in NBA Cup play.
